Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. The New Zealand players stride out to the middle. Followed by the opening pair of Bangladesh. Mohammad Naim and Liton Das. Ajaz Patel to start with the ball.

Wickets in cluster for the hosts! Oh boy, what did we just witness? Bangladesh are certainly the kings in their home background. They never took time to start taking wickets and put the Kiwis on the backfoot instantly. Mahedi Hasan was the one who drew the first blood. It was a complete team effort. All the bowlers enjoyed success in their spell except Mahmudullah. Nasum Ahmed and Shakib Al Hasan got two wickets to their name and so did Mohammad Saifuddin. Mustafizur Rahman was the pick of the bowlers with three wickets. So, now the onus will be on the batters to come out and chase the below-par target. Will the hosts take the lead in this series? To find out, do join us for the chase on the other side.

A batting collapse for the Kiwis! The two debutants Rachin Ravindra and Cole McConchie got the worst start to their international debuts, as they both got knocked out for naught. In fact, only two players scored in double digits for New Zealand. It was Tom Latham and Henry Nicholls but both got skittled out for 18 runs after getting starts. The batters could not negotiate well and were left in a terrible situation with a scoreline of 60/10.

Decimation, Yes, that is what has happened in the first half of the game. It was all about Bangladesh in the first innings. They were having a ball with the ball and New Zealand could not counter them well. The Kiwis got bundled out for 60 runs.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch by Mohammad Saifuddin! Length ball, around leg. Duffy looks to slog it but hits it high in the air straight down the ground. Mohammad Saifuddin runs back from mid on and puts in a dive to take a sensational catch. New Zealand are bowled out for 60!!
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Saifuddin b Mustafizur Rahman

OUT! TIMBER! The Bangladeshi spinners are on a roll. Ahmed gets his second wicket of the innings and New Zealand are four down in no time. Flatter and on off. Blundell goes back looking to make room for himself but it does not help. He looks to cut it away but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Bangladesh are dictating terms here.
Floated and on leg. Latham looks to defend it out and does so by chipping it to the left of the bowler. Ahmed puts in a dive but the ball evades him. The batters take a single.
Tossed up, on off. Latham defends it back to the bowlers.

Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Naim b Nasum Ahmed

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Mahedi Hasan has given the start that Bangladesh were looking for. An early breakthrough and Rachin Ravindra has to walk back on a duck. Looped up, on middle and leg. Ravindra looks to flick it away but only manages to chip it back to the bowler. Mahedi Hasan takes it without any trouble. Will Young will be the next batsman to walk in.
Looped up, full and just outside off. Blundell leans in and drives it to cover for a quick single. Tom Blundell and New Zealand are off the mark.
Hasan starts with a flighted one on off. Blundell defends it back to the bowler.
We are set for the action! Tom Blundell and Rachin Ravindra walk out to bat for New Zealand. Mahedi Hasan to start with the ball.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that they have played very well in the last couple of series and would look to continue just that. Adds that they are looking to keep up with the winning momentum and get a win in this game.

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, says that the preparation has been great so far. Adds that these conditions are very different from what they have back home. Says that they have an inexperienced squad and that provides an opportunity to players who have not played much cricket so far. Informs that Rachin Ravindra and Cole McConchie will make their debut.
Pitch Report - Atul Wassan says that the pitch has a dark tinge to it and the spinners will get the ball to turn. Adds that the batters will have a tough time in this game.

Bangladesh (PLAYING XI) - Mohammad Naim, Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Nasum Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
New Zealand (PLAYING XI) - Rachin Ravindra, Tom Blundell, Will Young, Colin de Grandhomme, Tom Latham (C &WK), Henry Nicholls, Cole McConchie, Doug Bracewell, Ajaz Patel, Blair Tickner, Jacob Duffy.
Toss - The news from the middle is that New Zealand have won the toss and they will BAT FIRST!

Hello and a very warm welcome to the first T20I between Bangladesh and New Zealand. In their own backyard, the Bangla Tigers are a force to reckon with and they proved just that when they thrashed Australia by a 4-1 margin. They will surely go into this clash as firm favorites. New Zealand are without their main players for this series so this gives the perfect opportunity to test their bench before the T20 World Cup. Who will come out on top? What will the teams look like? How will the pitch play? Stick with us as we find out together.
